name: Michaele Moraca
bioAdditions: Michele was baptized on 2 June 1748, son of Luca Moraca and Lucrezia Frajacouo (S1). His parents are new to the tree. His children Agata (1777) and Alessio (1772) are both John's ancestors.

relationships.evidence: Alessio bapt. 1772 (father Michaele, mother Anna Maria Putero)
